'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Keith Brown LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Keith Brown]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Keith Brown / DJK1, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations|VB9-L-republicatwar-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' DJK1
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
